Overview

Porto Alegre is a city in RS with a population of 1,492,530. Rio Grande do Sul’s capital, a cultural hub known for its gaúcho traditions, churrasco barbecue, and the Guaíba Lake waterfront. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
